name: W.E.B. Du Bois
shortBio: American sociologist, historian, and civil rights leader; pioneered empirical urban sociology, the color line problem, and the concept of double consciousness.
centralQuestion: What does it mean to gaze at one's soul through the veil of a world that looks on in amused contempt and pity?

keyWorks.title: The Philadelphia Negro
keyWorks.description: First scientific empirical sociological case study of an African American urban community.

keyWorks.title: The Souls of Black Folk
keyWorks.description: Seminal essays introducing the veil and double consciousness in American racial life.
